description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv4, which extends SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1. It provides utility functions for interacting with the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM web services, including fetching module views, data listings, field lists, handling batch entries, session validation, and subpanel definitions. The class is part of the web service layer enabling external access to CRM data and functionality.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv4
classes.description: A utility class for SugarCRM web services, providing methods for module view retrieval, data listing, field handling, session management, and subpanel definitions.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Retrieves view definitions for a specified module, view type, and layout, considering access controls.

methods.name: get_data_list
methods.description: Fetches a list of data records from a specified seed object with ordering, filtering, pagination, and favorites filtering support.

methods.name: getModulesFromList
methods.description: Converts a list of module keys into a format suitable for web services, checking user access rights.

methods.name: is_favorites_enabled
methods.description: Indicates if a given module supports favorites; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: filter_fields_for_query
methods.description: Processes a SugarBean's field definitions to prepare for a list query, filtering by requested fields.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Returns a structured list of module fields and link fields based on the provided SugarBean, optionally translating labels.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Handles creation or updating of multiple records in a module from name-value lists, with support for duplicates, associations, and optional field selection.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Validates OAuth or session-based access to a module at the specified access level.

methods.name: checkOAuthAccess
methods.description: Performs OAuth token validation, sets up session context, and assigns the current user object.

methods.name: get_subpanel_defs
methods.description: Loads subpanel definitions for a module, filtered by ACL permissions.
